data.title: Tile preview loses its 12px gap: refreshPreviews resets style.display, wiping inline display:grid

data.body: Found during PM-13 review. createTilePreview sets root.style.display='grid' (with 12px gap) inline; refreshPreviews in src/main.ts restores visibility with style.display='' which wipes that, so the swatch column stacks without its gap after the first mode switch. Fix direction: move display:grid/gap into a CSS class instead of inline styles (or toggle visibility via hidden attribute). Well-understood, backlog.

Fixed by orchestrator: tile preview root now carries className tp-col; display:grid + gap:12px moved to .tp-col in app.css; inline style lines deleted. style.display='' now falls back to the class rule. tsc+build clean.

Reviewed commit 9cc3d17 cold against the plan. Verified: tile-preview root now created with className tp-col and both inline style lines (display:grid, gap:12px) deleted; .tp-col { display: grid; gap: 12px; } added to app.css next to the other tp-* rules; main.ts refreshPreviews (lines 722-733) still toggles style.display = ""/"none" and the empty string now falls back to the class rule, so the gap survives mode round-trips; border preview root untouched and needs no change (its layout lives on the .bp-grid child, not the toggled root). Commit touches exactly the two planned files (src/preview/tile-preview.ts, src/styles/app.css). npx tsc --noEmit and npm run build both clean. No findings. Verdict: pass — meets all acceptance criteria.
